name: Kõnele
tagline: Speak instead of typing, in any app
description:
Kõnele is a speech-to-text keyboard and voice input service. Tap the microphone in any app and what you say is written out for you.

It can use a recogniser running on your own server, which makes it a good choice for languages the big services ignore, and it has been quietly maintained for well over a decade.
